The issuer demonstrates strong profitability and a significant equity base, with net income of $685M and retained earnings of $7,099M. However, the balance sheet exhibits high leverage, evidenced by a total liabilities-to-assets ratio of approximately 80% ($29,548M in liabilities against $37,024M in total assets) and a high liabilities-to-equity ratio of over 5.2x. This substantial debt burden relative to revenue ($3,580M) places the company in the lower investment-grade spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
